content: Windows debloat/tweak tools (WinUtil, ShutUp10, Win11Debloat) share a common shape: categorized toggle-based tweaks (safe 'standard' vs risky 'advanced'), bulk bloatware app removal (40+ apps), install/update automation for common software, restore-point creation before applying changes, and optional deeper actions like custom debloated ISO creation. Structure is consistently: curated app installer + toggle tweaks + debloat list + safety net.
